The axe forgets, but the tree remembers.
A tree that survives the strongest storms does not remain the same tree. It becomes stronger because of what it survived.
The river never argues with the mountain. It simply keeps moving. And eventually, it finds its way around it.
Some doors close without warning. Do not spend your life knocking on them. There may be a better door waiting behind you.
A seed spends its darkest days underground. What looks like burial from the outside may actually be the beginning of growth.
The person who learns to walk alone will never be afraid of an empty road. They will simply choose where to go next.
